title: Quant Is Building the Layer the Banks Let In
description: $QNT sits at rank 34 with around a $2.9 billion market cap, and the 25 largest banks in America just picked the company behind it to build their tokenised deposit network.

I break down what Quant actually does with the islands of money story, who is using it from the Bank of England to The Clearing House, what the token is for, and how $QNT stacks up against the total market, its peers and $BTC.
